plugins.name: pm-job-search
plugins.description: For senior product leaders running a job search. Finds open roles, scores fit, tracks your pipeline, runs live interview practice, and gives you an honest career coach. Markdown by default — optional browser dashboard and MCP integrations on top.

plugins.name: job-sweep
plugins.description: A weekly sweep for open product roles that match you, and remembers what it already showed you. Standalone — no pipeline tracking, no scoring rubric, no company folders. Upgrade to pm-job-search when you want the rest.
